subject: Request: Order Form Addendum — Capacity Top-up & Rate Exception
messages:
From: Anna Perez <anna.perez@acmehealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acmehealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Addendum request — 150k token top-up + temporary rate exception

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Our engineering team expects an immediate burst of inference traffic for a pilot running through the end of the quarter. We need to add a 150k-token top-up to the existing order form and, separately, are requesting a temporary rate exception for the pilot (we estimate 4–6 weeks).

Can you share the quickest path to get an addendum executed? Our procurement prefers: (1) an order-form addendum we can sign, (2) a short note documenting the temporary rate exception and end date, and (3) confirmation of no change to data residency or retention.

Attached: current_orderform_signed.pdf for reference.

Anna
Anna Perez
Sr. Program Manager, Cloud Integrations
Acme Health

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Addendum request — 150k token top-up + temporary rate exception

Anna — thanks for the note and the PDF. Looping in Laura (commercial) and Rishi (legal) to scope the addendum and the rate exception language. Quick answers up front:

- We can do a 150k token top-up as an addendum to your existing order form.
- Temporary rate exceptions are possible, but need explicit end date and an approval path (legal + revenue ops).
- No changes to data residency/retention required for a top-up; that stays under the MSA.

Laura — could you prepare a draft addendum and a one-paragraph rate-exception memo we can attach to DocuSign? Prefer to keep this to a single DocuSign envelope if possible.

Rishi — please advise on any contractual language we need for the rate exception (e.g., reversion to standard rates, proof points, audit rights). If you want a redlined order form, I can attach it here.

Target timeline: initial draft by Wed 10/07, legal review by 10/08, send to Acme for signature on 10/09. Any issues with that cadence?

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Thu, 07 Oct 2026 10:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Addendum request — 150k token top-up + temporary rate exception

Folks — reviewed the request. High-level comments:

1) Rate exception: include explicit start/end dates and a clear clause returning to the standard price schedule after the exception ends. Add a sentence that the exception applies only to usage attributable to the pilot project (define via project name or account tag).

2) Billing/prorations: confirm whether Acme wants the top-up invoiced upfront or applied as credits against future usage. If invoiced upfront, add refund terms for unused tokens (we usually pro-rate but can negotiate).

3) Audit & data residency: restating that the MSA covers data residency; include a short sentence "No changes to the MSA data-residency or retention obligations are made by this addendum."

4) Termination/backstop: add a short backstop that if the pilot exceeds 3x usage projections we reserve the right to convert to standard tier pricing upon 14 days notice — this protects capacity and economics. Keep it high-level.

I've attached a redlined Order Form with inline comments (redlined_orderform_v3.docx) and a one-page rate-exception memo (price_exception_summary.pdf). Laura — can you confirm commercial wording for invoicing and whether we approve prorated refunds? Also tagging Monica to confirm target dates.

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment(s): redlined_orderform_v3.docx (docx), price_exception_summary.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Anna Perez <anna.perez@acmehealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@acmehealth.com
Date: Fri, 09 Oct 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Addendum request — 150k token top-up + temporary rate exception

Anna / Acme team — attaching the redlined order form and a one-page rate exception memo for your review. Summary of changes:

- Addendum increases committed tokens by 150,000 for the pilot period (effective 10/10/2026) and automatically expires on 11/21/2026 (6 weeks).
- Temporary rate exception applies only to the pilot usage and reverts to standard rates on 11/22/2026.
- Billing option: Acme may choose (A) upfront invoiced top-up with pro-rated refund for unused tokens, or (B) credit application across invoices until the top-up is exhausted. Please indicate preference in your reply.
- Rishi included a protection clause allowing conversion to standard tier pricing if usage exceeds 3x projection with 14 days' notice.

Next steps:
1) Please review the redline and the memo.
2) Confirm billing preference and signatory.
3) Once confirmed, we'll send a single DocuSign envelope with the addendum + cover memo.

If you want a short call to speed this, I have availability tomorrow 10/10 between 9–11am PT.

Thanks, and cc'ing Procurement.

Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
